findings.why_flagged: Rule LLM-005 pattern matched

findings.description: LLM API call without retry / backoff — a single 429 or 5xx will fail the user request. Providers expect exponential backoff.
findings.fix_hint: Wrap the call in a retry-with-exponential-backoff helper (tenacity / backoff), or pass max_retries on the client if supported.
findings.test_hint: Simulate a 429 and assert the client retries before propagating.
findings.why_flagged: Rule LLM-008 pattern matched

findings.description: LLM streaming response created but not consumed via an (async) for loop — leaks an open HTTP connection until GC.
findings.fix_hint: Always iterate streamed responses: `async for chunk in client.chat.completions.create(stream=True, ...):` and close the stream in a finally block.
findings.test_hint: Assert the stream is fully consumed or explicitly closed.
findings.why_flagged: Rule LLM-009 pattern matched
